name: LLM Router
description: LLM Router local routing proxy for OpenClaw

configSchema.description: Provide either llm-router config or llm-router configPath. port, upstreamUrl, and trace override config.proxy.* at runtime.

config.description: Inline RawConfig passed directly to llm-router.

configPath.description: Path to a RawConfig JSON file for llm-router.

port.description: Runtime override config.proxy.port. Optional; if omitted, use the value from pluginConfig.config / configPath.

upstreamUrl.description: Runtime override config.proxy.upstreamUrl. Optional; if omitted, use the value from pluginConfig.config / configPath.
